groups.root_cause: Catalog additions that bring back a model referenced by saved routing rules are not checked against those rules, so a mismatch in supported settings only fails at the next daemon startup.
Resolving saved references rejects the whole resume or retry when any referenced model is retired, instead of skipping retired entries and using the available targets or fallbacks.
The remote-host validation in local management is too strict and rejects IPv6 addresses before SSH is invoked.
The remote host value is passed to SSH without blocking option-like values (such as a leading dash), so SSH treats it as an option and status can falsely report the service as active.

Providers are linked to the remote host only by an exact match on http://<remote_host>:8080, so SSH aliases or other ports break enabling/disabling the provider and the health check, which also omits the API key.
No end-to-end test covers reading the [local].remote_* keys from config.toml into local management.
